🛡 About Us

Security that never sleeps

nTrust.ai builds autonomous cybersecurity and compliance systems for organizations that cannot afford downtime, breaches, or audit surprises. Our solutions are engineered with enterprise-grade security from day one — and every engagement is delivered with radical transparency.

Our platform is aligned with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and the EU AI Act, enabling continuous security assurance and audit-ready operations.
